binary64_contract.running_point_domain: mdot_Xe > 0 and V_d > 0; every published scalar must be finite
binary64_contract.nonrelativistic_gate: computed Xe2+ speed must be <= 0.01 c
binary64_contract.fraction_policy: the exact rational sum of the three binary64 inputs is compared with unity; discrepancies no larger than two exact ULPs at unity are deterministically normalized
binary64_contract.ppu_boundary_policy: required load is canonically computed with stable summation; requested values within four scale-aware ULPs are snapped to that effective load and produce +0.0 loss; requested/effective/adjustment metadata remain distinct
binary64_contract.tiny_state_policy: Isp is evaluated directly from charge-state-weighted exhaust speed, not thrust divided by mass flow
binary64_contract.scaled_arithmetic_policy: ratios and products separate binary exponents where regrouping could destroy a representable custom-mass or custom-flow result
binary64_contract.undefined_efficiency_policy: a zero represented input-power denominator produces null/None efficiency rather than a fabricated 0/0 value
binary64_contract.backend_policy: Python canonical validation/preparation runs before Warp launch; Warp results are rejected before publication if any scalar is nonfinite

constants.provenance: 131.293 u standard atomic weight times the atomic mass constant

equations.provenance: mass conservation for one xenon atomic mass
equations.validity_domain: steady mdot_Xe > 0; finite representable particle rate; Xe, Xe+, and Xe2+ use the same atomic mass; electron mass neglected

equations.expression: Ndot_z = f_z Ndot_Xe; f_0 + f_1 + f_2 = 1
equations.provenance: definition of number fraction and particle conservation
equations.validity_domain: three represented xenon charge states: Xe, Xe+, Xe2+; exact-rational two-ULP normalization policy stated in binary64_contract

equations.provenance: ionized xenon mass divided by inlet xenon mass for equal species masses
equations.validity_domain: no unrepresented xenon charge states or condensates

equations.expression: v_z = sqrt(2 z e V_d / m_Xe), z in {1,2}
equations.provenance: nonrelativistic work-energy theorem, z e V_d = m_Xe v_z^2 / 2
equations.validity_domain: V_d > 0; collisionless acceleration from negligible directed inlet speed; Xe2+ speed <= 0.01 c
steady extracted Xe+ and Xe2+ beam
pressure thrust, neutral directed momentum, inlet momentum, and facility effects omitted

equations.provenance: definition of supplied axial momentum fraction
equations.validity_domain: k_div in [0,1] supplied externally; not predicted by L0
equations.confidence: high for accounting; closure confidence external

equations.expression: Isp = F_axial / (mdot_Xe g0) = k_div (f_1 v_1 + f_2 v_2) / g0
equations.validity_domain: mdot_Xe > 0; direct exhaust-speed form is used to preserve representable tiny values

equations.provenance: derived by substituting PHY-L0-004 into PHY-L0-009 and using PHY-L0-005
equations.validity_domain: verified conservation identity, not an independent closure

equations.expression: I_a = I_b / k_b; P_anode = V_d I_a
equations.provenance: definition of supplied beam-current fraction and electrical power
equations.validity_domain: k_b in (0,1] supplied externally; L0 does not predict discharge-current losses
equations.confidence: high for accounting; closure confidence external

equations.expression: P_thruster = fsum(P_anode,P_cathode); P_PPU_effective = canonical(P_PPU_requested,P_thruster); P_PPU_loss = P_PPU_effective - P_thruster
equations.validity_domain: requested PPU input within four scale-aware ULPs of canonical required load is represented by the effective required load and +0.0 loss; larger deficits are rejected
all ratios use the same effective power values; a represented zero denominator returns null/None because 0/0 is undefined
axisymmetric cylindrical coordinates; A_phi(0,z)=+0.0; exponent-scaled half-product preserves representable normal/subnormal outputs and rejects only nonrepresentable products

equations.provenance: cylindrical curl of an axisymmetric azimuthal vector potential
equations.validity_domain: analytic r->0 limit used on the symmetry axis

excluded_claims: No Kornfeld residual system or disputed residual sign is implemented.
No unknown beam-current, divergence, ionization, cathode, or wall-loss closure is calibrated.
No FEM solver exists in this workstream.
L0 outputs are verification baselines, not experimentally validated thruster predictions.
